sources.extraction_signal: Lexical risk factors, accounting changes, and management discussion anomalies in 10-K and 10-Q filings.
sources.access_strategy: Public HTTPS GET to /submissions/CIK{cik_number}.json with a compliant corporate User-Agent header.
sources.production_gate: Confirm SEC fair-access policy, User-Agent contact, retention policy, and filing parser coverage.

sources.extraction_signal: Japanese equity OHLC bars, margin balance changes, short-sale values, and TDnet disclosures.

sources.production_gate: Confirm subscription tier, API-key custody, TDnet licensing, and Japanese-market calendar handling.

sources.extraction_signal: SEC filing index, earnings transcripts, insider transactions, and global business press releases.

sources.production_gate: Confirm adjusted-price definitions, corporate-action handling, and storage rights.

sources.production_gate: Confirm identifier precedence, duplicate-resolution rules, and rate-limit handling.

sources.extraction_signal: Fundamental balance sheets, dividend schedules, and stock split histories.
